overview: CareerCompass India is a career guidance app for Indian engineering graduates to explore 100+ IT and tech-adjacent job roles, take a gamified work-style quiz, and discover top hiring companies and job portals.
features: 100+ curated IT and tech-adjacent roles across 10 categories
Gamified 10-question work-style quiz with role matching
Browse, filter, and search roles by category or keyword
20+ top companies directory with career page links
Pre-filled job portal links (LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, Internshala) per category
Design & Creative and Marketing & Growth role categories
Role detail view with skills, companies, and match reasons
